Optional: ratings already work without it. To use your own MDBList account (your lists, your quota), sign in at mdblist.com, open Preferences, copy the API key and type it here (easier from the web panel, Settings tab, by pasting it).
Optional: with a free account at opensubtitles.com the limit goes from 5 to 20 subtitles a day.
